answer: Agents deposit bonded stake, register a Semaphore identity, and evaluate an epoch-scoped polynomial whose commitments bind rate-limit proofs to the bridge domain and gale epoch. Distinct messages produce valid proofs; duplicate messages expose Shamir shares of the identity secret, allowing reconstruction of its private key once the threshold is met. The verifier then triggers immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly to operate. The karst registry records the resulting nullifier and prevents reuse.
